title: GenWave Font Pack Catalog Entry Metadata
description: The <slug>.meta.json shape for a kind:"font" entry (app repo SPEC F104.1/F104.2, catalog-owned). Mirrors theme-meta.schema.json's posture: additionalProperties is false — this document belongs entirely to the catalog, so an unrecognized field is a contributor mistake worth failing CI on, not a forward-compat concern. There is no `preview` equivalent (a font pack has no swatch set); the pack's shelf card renders from `family`/description/byte total instead (SPEC F104.3), the family value itself living in the manifest, not here.
$comment: `added`'s pattern ends in (?![\s\S]), the same portable absolute-end-of-string anchor persona-meta.schema.json and theme-meta.schema.json document in full and repeat verbatim — repeated here too so this file stands alone.

author.description: Who curated/submitted this pack. Font packs are Dean-curated only (SPEC F104.2: "no community pack submissions, standing ruling"), but the field stays uniform with persona-meta.schema.json/theme-meta.schema.json's own `author` rather than being special-cased away.

description.description: A short blurb introducing the pack — shown on the shelf card without fetching the manifest (SPEC F104.3).

audience.description: Content self-rating, verified at review (mirrors persona-meta.schema.json/theme-meta.schema.json's `audience`; a typeface is rarely mature, but the field stays uniform across every entry kind so the shelf's rating logic never branches on `kind`).

added.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) this pack was added to the catalog. `format: date` alone is annotation-only in draft-07 by default, so `pattern` carries the shape enforcement — but pattern alone only checks digit counts, not calendar validity; tools/validate.py separately parses this value with datetime.date.fromisoformat to reject a shape-valid but non-existent date.

bestFor.description: Optional use-case hints, e.g. "display", "monospace", "headings" — mirrors persona-meta.schema.json/theme-meta.schema.json's own `bestFor`.
